description:
A persona's face and image library. list_faces: the stock faces to pick an avatar from (id, url, description). list_images / add_image (reads a local file) / update_image / remove_image: the library images used for the per-video image selection. get_card: the persona's identity card (set with personas update identityCard), or null. render_prompt: renders a deterministic image-edit prompt from the card plus a scene (outfit, pose, setting, lighting, framing) and returns { prompt, suggestedDescription }; it is advice for YOUR image tool, nothing is generated or stored. Workflow: render_prompt, make the image with your own tool from the persona's base photo, add_image with description = suggestedDescription, then use the new photos in generate_video options.lipsyncPhotos for full_lipsync. The card describes a real person's physical traits: nude or sexualised clothing is rejected, and the server cannot police what your image tool makes. A persona's face and its library images live in persona_media; an image for one video segment is media (action: upload).
Actions and their required fields: list_faces (no required fields); list_images (persona); add_image (persona, path); update_image (id); remove_image (id); get_card (persona); render_prompt (persona, scene).

action.description: What to do: list_faces | list_images | add_image | update_image | remove_image | get_card | render_prompt. The description lists the fields each action needs.

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

id.description: The library image ID to update

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (false is rejected — a new image is not primary unless marked)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

scene.description: Only what changes per photo: outfit (slots top, bottom, one_piece, outerwear, footwear, accessories), pose, setting, lighting, framing, aspect. Identity, face, body and version keys are rejected, and so are words about the person (hair, skin, body) in the free text.

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

name: persona_media
